description: Cogitate (2025): adding prefrontal regions to posterior regions did not improve, and sometimes reduced, decoding of category and orientation in iEEG and MEG.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered.

sources.quote: adding prefrontal ROIs did not improve—and in some cases reduced—category and orientation decoding
